$comment: Request lifecycle. scripts/check.mjs asserts that the RequestStatus enum in openapi/openapi.yaml equals 'states' and that every transition names known states. docs/requests.md draws the same machine.

transitions.on: policy either: first approve. policy both: last outstanding decider approves
neededBy passed with no final decision

policies.either: The first eligible decider's approve or decline is final.
policies.both: Approved only when every listed decider has approved. Declined as soon as any decider declines.

rules: Each decider may record one verdict per request. A second verdict from the same decider is rejected with 409.
Deciders are fixed when the request is created (from the routing rules) and stored on the request. Later rule edits do not change open requests.
A requester is never a decider on their own request.
A member listed in hiddenFrom never sees the request, its decisions or its audit detail.
